summary: gdn-attention-metadata-builder.build takes no seq_lens and returns no checkpoint; MambaPrefillCheckpointBuilder and KimiK3ROCmKDAMetadataBuilder are missing, so offsets [192, 64] and state indices [2, 4] can't be produced.

VllmConfig.try_verify_and_update_config / MODELS_CONFIG_MAP is missing, so LlamaBidirectionalConfig never sets is_causal=False and MEAN pooling; seq pooling, attn_type, prefix caching and chunked prefill all disagree. The MTEB score part is untranslatable.
No interface for jit_warmup_triton_helper.triton_scalar_specialization_rep; the JIT warmup is only a ctx.jit_warmup flag. Missing entity, low severity.
Asserts numeric tensor equality of the baddbmm attention against a reference, plus output shapes and contiguity: kernel numerics and memory layout, below the model's level.
Gemma4ImagePixelInputs has no entity: gemma4_mm is a registry row, and TensorSchema is modeled only as Phi3V's fixed shape, which can't take (bn, np, pp).
All 4 parameters give model_type qwen3_5_mtp, the expected architecture and n_predict 1, through the Qwen3.5 row of speculative-config.hf-config-override.
DecoderReplayLayers and DeepseekV41ModelState have no entity: DeepseekV41ForCausalLM is only a registry row, so the KV-write-then-replay control flow can't run.
